passages.v03:c16:p0053: “It is quite an outmoded method,” she remarked, busily working her needles on an item as delicate and rosy as an evening cloud. “However, I am outmoded myself. My garments are, and naturally my views are as well. Remember, I am not claiming they are superior because of it. Indeed, I suppose they are likely much inferior. Nevertheless, they have proven quite comfortable through use. Fresh footwear looks finer than worn footwear, yet the worn footwear feels more pleasant. I have reached an age where I can pamper myself regarding footwear and views. My intention is to be very relaxed here. I am aware you anticipate that I will supervise you and maintain your propriety, yet I refuse. If you will ever understand how to conduct yourselves, you are at an age to know it now. Therefore, as it pertains to me,” Aunt Euphemia finished, a gleam present in her youthful eyes, “you are all free to ruin yourselves as you see fit.”
